items.name: func_get
items.summary: Get one or more functions with selected sections: summary, disassembly, IR, decompiled C, xrefs, callers, callees, strings, variables, notes, why, CFG and jump tables.

items.name: func_list
items.summary: List and filter the functions of a binary, and sort them by address, name, size or priority.

items.name: func_edit
items.summary: Create or delete functions and override the analysis: noreturn, jump-table targets, flow, indirect call targets and references.

items.name: func_similar
items.summary: Find functions similar to target functions in the open binaries, explain each match and propose names.

items.name: fact_check
items.summary: Check claims with supported, refuted or unknown verdicts, and explain why a fact exists.

items.name: comment_set
items.summary: Set or clear the comments at addresses.

items.name: batch_run
items.summary: Run up to 32 dependent tool steps in one batch call, with references, guards and one transaction for edits.
